# AI Page Ready

> AI Page Ready helps SEO and digital marketing agencies create white-label AEO audit reports for inbound lead generation and outbound prospecting. Agencies can embed an audit widget on their websites or use Prospector to generate reports for businesses they select.

AI Page Ready helps agencies turn website traffic into qualified opportunities for AEO, GEO, AI SEO, and content services. A prospect enters a page URL, receives useful reports immediately, and the agency receives the prospect's details and results for a more informed follow-up.

Prospector supports outbound campaigns. An agency adds a list of prospect webpages, configures one report setup, and generates an individual shareable web report and branded PDF for every successful audit.

The product provides customizable widgets, branded web and PDF reports, support for 24 languages, and email delivery of each prospect's contact details, submitted website, web report, and PDF.

## Who It Is For

- SEO agencies
- Digital marketing agencies
- AEO, GEO, and AI-search consultants
- Agencies that want to offer an automated first audit before a deeper manual engagement

## How the AEO Audit Widget Works

1. An agency customizes the widget, form fields, language, reports, and branding.
2. The agency embeds one code snippet on its website.
3. A prospect submits a page URL and contact details.
4. AI Page Ready generates an AI Search Readiness Audit and, when enabled, an AI Search Visibility Report.
5. The prospect receives immediate value, while the agency receives a high-intent lead with the submitted website and completed reports.

The widget can be embedded on WordPress, Webflow, HubSpot, Squarespace, Wix, Framer, or any website that accepts custom HTML.

Agencies can place the audit as a standard inline form, popup, corner widget, side widget, or top bar. The standard form is included on Free; all five options are available on Growth and Scale. The floating options can be shown or hidden separately on mobile and desktop.

## Reports

### AI Search Readiness Audit

The readiness audit runs more than 40 checks across schema markup, LLM-friendly content and formatting, accessibility, discoverability, readability, and page performance. It explains what may be holding a page back in AI search and provides a practical starting point for an agency's AEO, GEO, and AI SEO services.

### AI Search Visibility Report

The visibility report checks whether ChatGPT and Gemini recommend the prospect's brand or competing brands for relevant questions. It also shows sources cited by AI answers and brand sentiment findings drawn from sampled responses.

## Product Features

- Customizable, embeddable AEO audit widget
- AI Search Readiness Audit with more than 40 checks
- AI Search Visibility reporting across ChatGPT and Gemini
- Interactive web reports and downloadable PDF reports
- White-label widget, report, email, logo, and agency contact options on eligible plans
- Lead capture with customizable form fields
- Lead and report delivery by email
- Support for analytics event snippets on eligible plans
- Completed sample reports for evaluating the prospect experience
- No-code setup using a single embed snippet
- Prospector campaigns for generating white-label AEO reports for multiple outbound prospects

## Languages

The complete widget and report experience is available in 24 languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Portuguese (Portugal), Indonesian, Polish, Vietnamese, Dutch, Turkish, Romanian, Japanese, Swedish, Norwegian, Hungarian, Finnish, Estonian, Danish, Malay, Korean, Thai, and Arabic.

## Plans

- Free: Includes five widget leads per month, an embeddable audit widget, English AI Readiness Reports with AI Page Ready branding, report customization, and basic email support. It has no subscription fee and is not time-limited.
- Growth: The entry paid plan for small agencies. It includes 20 widget leads per month, 20 outbound prospect audits, a customizable white-label widget, all 24 supported languages, and email support.
- Scale: For agencies running the widget at higher volume. It includes 100 widget leads per month and adds emails from the agency's domain, custom JavaScript for analytics events, account management, priority support, and early access to new features.
- Enterprise: For large agencies that need unlimited leads, support for new language requests, a dedicated account manager, and custom CRM integrations.

See the pricing page for current prices, allowances, trial terms, and the complete feature comparison.

## Guides and Resources

- [Understanding AEO](https://aipageready.com/ai-seo-guide): Technical guidance for making pages easier for search engines and AI systems to discover, understand, and cite.
- [AEO vs GEO vs SEO](https://aipageready.com/guides/aeo-vs-geo-vs-seo): A practical agency guide to overlapping search terminology, shared work, illustrated search experiences and separate readiness, mention, citation and business metrics.
- [What Is an AEO Audit Widget?](https://aipageready.com/guides/what-is-an-aeo-audit-widget): A practical guide to how agencies use an embedded AEO audit to give prospects useful reports and capture better-qualified leads.
- [AEO Audit Widget Setup Guide](https://aipageready.com/guides/set-up-aeo-audit-widget): Step-by-step instructions for configuring report sections, report subdomains, and custom domains, customizing and embedding the widget, and testing it on WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, Wix, Framer, and custom websites.
- [Prospector Setup Guide](https://aipageready.com/guides/how-to-use-prospector): Step-by-step instructions for creating outbound campaigns, configuring reports, adding prospect webpages, monitoring progress, and using web and PDF reports in outreach.
- [Humans vs LLMs](https://aipageready.com/humans-vs-llms): An interactive tool that shows how an LLM interprets a webpage, scores how clearly the page communicates its purpose, and helps produce a more accurate description of the page.
- [AI SEO Prompts](https://aipageready.com/ai-seo-prompts): Prompts for reviewing and improving AI-search readiness.
- [Agency Audit Widget Revenue Calculator](https://aipageready.com/tools/agency-roi-calculator): Free calculator comparing estimated monthly leads, new clients, and new MRR from contact forms and an audit widget using editable assumptions. Includes calculation formulas and an illustrative example; results exclude costs, profit, churn, and existing clients.
